angle_en: Arjuna asks which of two types of devotees are better yogis
angle_hi: अर्जुन पूछते हैं कि दोनों में से उत्तम योगवेत्ता कौन हैं

en.intro: Krishna has just shown Arjuna his universal form. Now, before the war resumes, Arjuna asks a sharp question about the two paths of worship.
en.notice: Arjuna asks who are the best yogis: those who worship Krishna personally, or those who worship the unmanifest, formless absolute.
en.next: Krishna answers that those who worship him with unwavering devotion and supreme trust are the highest yogis.
en.meaning: Arjuna says: Those devotees who worship You with constant devotion, and those who worship the imperishable, unmanifest reality, who among them are the most accomplished in yoga?

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी अर्जुन को अपना विश्वरूप दिखाया है। अब, युद्ध शुरू होने से पहले, अर्जुन दो तरह के भक्तों के बारे में एक सवाल पूछते हैं।
hi.meaning: अर्जुन पूछते हैं, जो भक्त निरन्तर आपमें लगे रहकर आपकी उपासना करते हैं और जो अविनाशी निराकार की उपासना करते हैं, उनमें से उत्तम योगवेत्ता कौन हैं?
hi.notice: अर्जुन पूछते हैं कि सबसे उत्तम योगवेत्ता कौन हैं: वे जो कृष्ण की व्यक्तिगत रूप से उपासना करते हैं, या वे जो निराकार परमेश्वर की उपासना करते हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण उत्तर देते हैं कि जो बिना डगमगाए भक्ति से उनकी उपासना करते हैं, वे ही मेरे विचार में सबसे ऊँचे योगवेत्ता हैं।

en.intro: Krishna has just shown Arjuna his universal form. Now, before the war resumes, Arjuna asks a sharp question about the two paths of worship.
en.body: Arjuna says: Those devotees who worship You with constant devotion, and those who worship the imperishable, unmanifest reality, who among them are the most accomplished in yoga? Arjuna asks who are the best yogis: those who worship Krishna personally, or those who worship the unmanifest, formless absolute. Krishna answers that those who worship him with unwavering devotion and supreme trust are the highest yogis.
